name: SuiteUI sources
description: The shared design system (Sources/SuiteUI): spacing, radius, size, type and color tokens; Liquid Glass applied in one snapshot-aware place (Glass) and GlassPanel; the SuiteWindow shell (sidebar, content, inspector) with SidebarSection and SidebarRow; ToolbarGroup palette actions; the content layer (CanvasSurface, SurfaceCard, EmptyStateView, ViewerStatusBar); the editor shell after the Ripple editor (EditorShell, EditorTopBar and its bar items, the docked ToolbarGroup rail, CanvasViewport with its Ruler, optional checkerboard, ZoomMath clamped zoom and fit, and CanvasMarks, SegmentedTabs and the ColorWell hex row); pro inspector parts (InspectorHeader, InspectorRows, ScrubField and NumericInput number entry); the Studio easing parts (CurveEditor, StudioScrubRow, ChoiceChips); ThumbnailGrid with its selection math; and TimelineStrip with its frame mapping, shared by Flare and Halo.
